Curvature-Constrained 2D Gradient Estimation refines standard 2D gradient estimation by restricting normal computation to pixels within the same continuous curvature region, preventing the blurring of sharp features across disjoint object boundaries [S1, book].

The claim accurately reflects the content of Source [S1]. The source explicitly states that standard estimation can lead to blurring because normals are computed from disjoint regions, and proposes a refinement where normals are estimated using only pixels within the same continuous curvature region to prevent this blurring. It also details the use of forward/backward differences and reduced step sizes as part of this method.
